text: Hello, my mother (82) fell in her flat in Neuss about an hour ago. She is not badly hurt but cannot get up on her own and I am stuck at work. Can someone go there right now? Please call me back immediately. - Jonas Weber
My father ran out of his heart medication. The pharmacy has it ready. Can someone pick it up and bring it to him in Krefeld today? He cannot leave the house.
I need a ride to the hospital in Essen this afternoon for my dialysis appointment at 3 pm. My usual driver just cancelled. Regards, Helga Sommer

Guten Tag, meine Oma in Düsseldorf hat seit gestern nichts mehr gegessen, der Kühlschrank ist leer und sie kann nicht einkaufen gehen. Bitte heute noch jemanden schicken! Rufen Sie mich bitte zurück, am besten abends. Grüße, Petra Lange
my dad has dementia and he wandered out this morning, police found him, now he's home in Ratingen but i need someone to sit with him today until 6 pm while i'm at work. pls hurry

Subject: urgent. Our neighbour Mrs. Albers (90) has not answered her door since yesterday and her curtains are still closed. We have a key but we are away. Could your team check on her today in Hilden? Please call me on my mobile as soon as possible. Tom Brückner
I had eye surgery this morning and I'm not allowed to drive. I need to get home from the clinic in Köln by 2 pm today.

hallo, mein mann ist gestürzt und hat sich das bein verletzt, der arzt war schon da aber wir brauchen heute noch jemand der für uns einkauft und die medikamente aus der apoteke holt. wir wohnen in Mönchengladbach.

The heating in my mother's flat broke and it is 12 degrees inside. She is 88. Can someone come today, bring her blankets and stay with her until the technician arrives tomorrow? She lives in Duisburg.
Please help, my grandmother is alone and confused and keeps calling me in tears. I can't get to her today. Can someone visit her today? Call me back please.
My wife's chemotherapy session was moved to today at 4 pm at the clinic in Wuppertal. I can't drive her. Can someone take her? Please confirm quickly.

Hello, I'm unexpectedly in hospital and my 79-year-old husband is at home in Solingen on his own. He cannot cook. Could someone bring him groceries and a warm meal today? Please call me back in the afternoon on the ward phone. Ingrid Hoffmann
Dringend: Meine Mutter (85) braucht heute einen Fahrdienst zur Notfallsprechstunde beim Hausarzt in Leverkusen, Termin um 11 Uhr. Bitte bestätigen Sie kurz. Martin Kühn
my aunt slipped in the bathroom yesterday, she's ok but scared to be alone. someone should be with her tonight. she lives near the station
Insulin needed today! My father's insulin pen is empty and his pharmacy in Meerbusch has a new one waiting. He can't walk there. Please call me back right away.
Could someone drive my father to his eye doctor appointment in Düsseldorf on Thursday at 10 am? He uses a walker.
I'd like weekly grocery shopping for my mother starting next week. She lives in Neuss. Please call me in the morning to discuss. Best, Sabine Kraus
Hallo, wir suchen ab nächster Woche Unterstützung im Haushalt für meinen Vater in Köln, zweimal pro Woche putzen und Wäsche waschen. Bitte rufen Sie mich zurück, nachmittags bin ich gut erreichbar.
My mum needs a lift to the dentist on Monday at 9:30. She lives in Krefeld.
Hi there, my grandfather would enjoy some company, maybe a walk twice a week. He lives in Essen. Could someone start this week? I'm easiest to reach in the evenings.
Can you help with the spring cleaning of my apartment in Ratingen on Saturday? Mainly windows and the kitchen.
Dear team, my mother has a hospital check-up next Wednesday at 8 am and needs transport there and back. She uses a wheelchair. Please call me back to arrange it. Kind regards, Frank Meier
hi, i need some1 to do shoping for me this friday, i broke my arm last week. live in Duisburg. thx
Guten Tag, könnte jemand meine Mutter in Hilden am Wochenende besuchen? Sie fühlt sich sehr einsam, seit mein Vater verstorben ist.
Next Sunday we have a family birthday party in Bonn. My father has dementia and we'd like someone to keep him company and look after him there for about 3 hours.
Please call me back tomorrow morning about help with laundry and ironing for my parents in Wuppertal this month. It has become too much for them.
My husband needs a ride to physiotherapy three times next week, Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 2 pm, in Solingen.
Could someone pick up a parcel from the post office and buy a few groceries for my neighbour in Mönchengladbach in the next couple of days?
Hello, my father needs some help this week. I'm not sure what exactly, he has been struggling since his operation. Can you call me in the afternoon?
hallo, brauche diese woche hilfe beim einkaufen, bin 78 und mein knie macht nicht mehr mit. wohne in leverkusen. am besten vormittags anrufen
Next Tuesday my mother is moving into a smaller flat in Meerbusch. Could someone help her unpack and tidy the kitchen afterwards?
I'd like someone to read to my blind grandmother and chat with her, ideally starting this week. She lives in Dortmund.
Hallo, ich brauche am 24. einen Fahrdienst zu einem Facharzttermin. Was kostet das? Gruß, Renate Vogel
My mum's cleaner quit. Can someone clean her flat in Düsseldorf before her birthday on Friday? Call me in the evening please.
Looking for someone to do the weekly shop for my dad in Köln, the first time this Thursday. He needs diabetic-friendly food.
Hello, do you also offer help with gardening? Just asking for the future.
What are your prices for companionship visits? My mother in Neuss might need them later this year.
Guten Tag, ich interessiere mich für Ihre Einkaufshilfe für meine Eltern in Krefeld. Können Sie mir Informationen zuschicken? Viele Grüße, Andreas Wolf
Hi, is it possible to book regular rides to the supermarket? Not urgent, just planning ahead. I live in Essen. Call me back sometime in the afternoon.
general question: do your helpers speak turkish? my grandma would feel more comfortable
I might need help cleaning my flat in Hilden after the summer. Could you send me a brochure?
Hello! My father would love a chess partner once a week. No rush at all. We're in Ratingen.

Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, wir planen für das nächste Jahr Unterstützung im Haushalt für meine Schwiegermutter. Bitte rufen Sie mich bei Gelegenheit morgens an. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Klaus Brandt
do u guys do trips to the cemetery? my mom wants to visit dad's grave now and then. we're in Duisburg
Is there a waiting list for weekly shopping help? I'm asking for my uncle in Wuppertal. He manages fine for now.
Hi, I saw your flyer. Could you tell me more about what you do?
My parents in Solingen are getting older and at some point they will need help with the household. What would that cost? Please call me back in the evening. Thanks, Julia Becker
Hi! Bietet ihr auch Begleitung zu Konzerten oder ins Theater an? Meine Oma liebt Musik. Wir wohnen in Bonn. Keine Eile :)
Can you send me information about transport to doctor appointments over the coming months? My grandfather in Meerbusch has regular check-ups.
Hallo, die Helferin, die letzten Monat für meine Mutter in Mönchengladbach eingekauft hat, war wunderbar. Könnten wir sie irgendwann wieder für den Einkauf buchen? Liebe Grüße, Monika Schulz
